nextSteps: No Orca workspace matched the worktree selector "new-child".
Did you mean: id:new-child::<absolute-path>, name:new-child, branch:new-child
Valid selector forms: id:<repo-id>::<absolute-path>, path:<absolute-path>, name:<display-name>, branch:<branch>, identity:<identity-key>, issue:<number>, current, active.
List the exact values with `orca worktree list --json`; a bare repository id is not a worktree id.
